name: smwsprites-giant-piranha-plants
title: Giant Piranha Plants
description:
This is the Giant Piranha Plant, originally from sprite tool, further adapted by Davros. Can be used in giant and regular bytes (size determined by extra bit). Extra Byte 1 controls the direction, stem length and aggressivity.

Now SA-1 and PIXI Compatible.
